gallery.title: File:Smithsonian American Art Museum National Portrait Gallery Exterior.jpg
gallery.artist: Frogvixen
gallery.source: Smithsonian American Art Museum National Portrait Gallery Exterior
gallery.description: Exterior of the building that the Smithsonian American Art Museum and the National Portrait Gallery share. It is a large building made of grey stone, a set of columns mark the entrance and a wide set of stairs lead up to the entrance. Above, the sun peeks through a cloudy sky. Three cars are parked in front of the building. Several people are walking toward the entrance, at the top of the stairs.
